correctness.rationale: Order-zero Bessel parameter derivative and Wronskian exactly yield the cubic expansion, while analytic implicit dependence permits twice differentiation. The checker is supplementary, not the proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source itself poses the fixed-index order-curvature sign question and only proves first-order monotonicity. Its §§2 and 8 and the older Baricz–Pogány primary survey do not contain either sharp endpoint curvature coefficient. The full published mathematical result “Inverse-square convergence of sharp cylinder-function Turán minima” was inspected: it fixes order and increases nodal index, so it does not imply the present order-curvature limits. Complete exclusion of unindexed literature is not claimed.
residual_risks: Obscure or poorly indexed earlier treatment of the second order derivative of optimized normalized Bessel Turánians could imply the same laws.
